expectations.text: Rejects the sign-up count as the health metric and states it is the number most likely to look healthy on an event about to run short mid-afternoon
expectations.evidence: "'144% subscribed' counts sign-ups, not coverage... A roster can balance over the day and still have a hole at 15:00."

expectations.text: Replaces it with post-hours covered as a share of the post-hours the schedule requires
expectations.evidence: Metric 1: "Post-hours covered as a share of post-hours required".

expectations.text: Requires that share to be computed per hour rather than as a daily total, because a roster that balances across the day still has a hole in it
expectations.evidence: Metric 1 is bolded "per hour"; the daily-balance hole is explained.

expectations.text: Adds the share of posts with a named backup as a separate metric from coverage
expectations.evidence: Metric 2: "Share of posts with a named backup".

expectations.text: Adds the no-show rate together with the share of no-shows where a replacement was confirmed before the post was left
expectations.evidence: Metric 5: "No-show rate, and the share of no-shows replaced before the post was left".

expectations.text: Sets briefing coverage before the first shift, including the escalation script, at a 100% target
expectations.evidence: Metric 3: "Share briefed on the escalation script before their first shift | 100%".

expectations.text: Flags the 31-of-78 optional webinar as failing that target and makes the briefing a gate on the first shift rather than an option
expectations.evidence: "31 of 78 is 40%... I'd make the briefing a condition of the first shift."

expectations.text: Adds the share of shifts that started on time, measured against published times with the arrival buffer included
expectations.evidence: Buffers are mentioned only as a checklist item; the on-time-start share is not among the metrics.

expectations.text: States the pass threshold: every post-hour covered by a named person with a named backup, and every volunteer briefed on the escalation script before their first shift
expectations.evidence: "Moves to green when every post-hour has a named person and a named backup, and every volunteer has completed the briefing."
